One-line description: Neighbourhood primary-care clinics with in-house diagnostics for Tier-2 cities.
What have you built?: Three 1,200 sq ft neighbourhood clinics in Hyderabad suburbs, each with a family doctor, in-house diagnostics and a pharmacy.
Revenue: INR 9.8 L across the three clinics in October 2026. The first clinic reached monthly breakeven in month 8.
Patient acquisition: About INR 210 per new patient. Local doctor referrals 45%, WhatsApp and Google listings 35%, health camps 20%.
Capex: INR 28 L per clinic, funded by angels and a INR 40 L bank loan.
Key risks: Capital intensity, doctor retention, and slower ramp in new locations.
Existing investors: Angels INR 60 L, bank loan INR 40 L.
Use of funds: Five new clinics, working capital, team and systems.
Founder background: Dr. Lakshmi Reddy (CEO): MBBS, 8 years in family medicine. Vikram Rao (COO): 6 years in operations at a hospital chain.
